Each row is one slot of the optical sensor. Pulsatile rows carry a heartbeat. Red should have a lower perfusion (PI) than infrared. Set the indices below or leave -1 for automatic. After a reference reading from a fingertip oximeter, enter it and tap Calibrate.

No SpO2 records in the last 7 days. Connect Google Health to Health Connect and sync.

Google Health only measures SpO2 during sleep and offers no API to start a reading. This app reads the watch\'s raw optical sensor directly and computes SpO2 from the red and infrared channels. Which channel is which is not documented by Google, so verify the assignment and calibrate against a real pulse oximeter before trusting the numbers.

Install the watch app from this phone

On the watch: Settings › System › About › Versions, tap Build number 7 times. Then Settings › Developer options › Wireless debugging (on, same Wi-Fi as the phone). Tap "Pair new device" and copy its IP, port and code here. The connect port is shown on the Wireless debugging screen itself.

Paired. Now enter the connect port and tap Install.
